children.text: Issues tab will list map leaks and validation findings.

widgets.text: Arrow keys move selection. Enter chooses. Esc closes.

3D editor: WASD move, RMB drag look, MMB drag pan, wheel zoom, Q/E down/up. Modes: Space select, B brush tool, V vertex, M texture, G objects. Prefabs button opens blockout shapes. Esc clears selection/back to select.
